evidence.name: SpecForge MVP Application CI
evidence.scope: Application test suite, independent OpenAPI validation, and configured SDK/browser checks for the exact checkout SHA.
limitations: CI success does not prove the unrun product test plan, authenticated customer acceptance, or production readiness.

evidence.name: G1 Contract Verification
evidence.scope: Contract and event-schema verification on the exact checkout SHA.
limitations: This does not close the six SpecForge product test-plan scenarios or domain signoff.

evidence.name: SpecForge PostgreSQL Runtime Proof
evidence.scope: Disposable PostgreSQL runtime proof for configured tenant/RLS and restore checks.
limitations: Disposable logical restore is not production PITR, regional failover, or RTO/RPO acceptance.

evidence.name: SpecForge staging public readiness smoke
evidence.scope: Public health/readiness and anonymous protected-route denial checks against the staging endpoint.
limitations: The deployed service SHA is not proven by this smoke record.
The smoke is not authenticated product or customer acceptance.
G1-D remains conditional/pending signoff and G1-E is partial/open/blocked; passing CI does not change those gates.
SF-T01 through SF-T06 are recorded as not run in the repository test plan at this baseline; these CI runs do not count as those product scenarios.
The staging smoke workflow commit does not identify the deployed application commit.
